category: Purview, DLP & data security for Copilot
title: Make Copilot respect sensitivity labels and encryption
problem: You need to know how labeled and encrypted content is handled in Copilot responses.
steps: Copilot applies the highest-priority label of referenced content to new content in supported scenarios (and it replaces a lower-priority manual label).
For encrypted content, Copilot needs the user to have both EXTRACT and VIEW usage rights.
To stop Copilot summarizing files at rest, use labels that apply encryption without the EXTRACT right. Test with a pilot user.
pitfalls: Content without the EXTRACT right won't be summarized — expected behavior, not a bug.
Container labels (sites, teams) aren't inherited by items, so Copilot won't show them for that content.
done_when: Sensitivity labels are published to the pilot users.
A pilot test confirms how Copilot handles a file with an encryption label that lacks the EXTRACT right, and the result matches your intent.
